## Follow-up: CodeRabbit advisory items from PR #696 (https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/696)

Captured at merge time; none block correctness today. Priority items first.

### Legit (worth fixing)
- **#3 (Major) single-agent-integrate.md ~line 181**: the ci-pr review-gating snippet uses a relative path `DSO_WORKFLOW=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config.sh dso.workflow ...)`. Anchor to `$ORCHESTRATOR_ROOT/.claude/scripts/dso` (set in Step 1b), consistent with the rest of the protocol, to avoid CWD-dependent failures.

### Optional hardening (currently false positives)
- **#1/#2 (Major, but FALSE POSITIVE today) ticket_graph/_links.py:_is_active_link + ticket-link.sh:_get_link_info/_is_duplicate_link**: SNAPSHOT fallback iterates `sorted(*-SNAPSHOT.json)` ascending and returns first match. This is correct given the current single-snapshot invariant (ticket-compact.sh skips compaction when a SNAPSHOT already exists, lines 99-104). If that invariant ever changes (multiple snapshots accumulate), add `reverse=True` / select newest snapshot to avoid resurrecting a removed dep. Defensive future-proofing only.

### Nits
- **#4 (trivial) test-ticket-delete-e2e.sh ~line 359**: mktemp template `.py` suffix outside the quotes; move inside for consistency.
- **#5 (minor) test-ticket-link.sh ~line 1347**: add a two-ID `--dry-run` case (`ticket link <id1> <id2> --dry-run`, no relation) to cover the arg-count interaction after --dry-run stripping (currently errors with usage — confirm that is the intended behavior or whether a 2-ID form is supported).

Source: PR #696 CodeRabbit review threads; analysis in debug-session epic 0786-8d7f-c049-459f.
